fields.description: The app whose catalogue or manifest registered this agent. Stamped by the registering app; empty means the row was written by hand in the Desk. Read-only here — an app that owns a row overwrites it on every reconcile, so editing this cannot change who owns it, only what this page claims.
fields.label: Source App

fields.description: Optional — shown in the Image (grid) list view. Agents without one get an auto-generated initial card there, so this is purely cosmetic.
fields.label: Avatar

fields.description: Feather icon name shown in workspace and sidebar links.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: The agent executes as this user, so every tool read is scoped by their Roles and row-level permissions. Leave empty to run as Administrator, which sees the whole site.
fields.label: Run As User

fields.description: Settings DocType shipped by the agent app (API keys, toggles).
fields.label: Settings DocType

fields.description: Custom UI Page shipped by the agent app; sidebar links here when set.
fields.label: Page

fields.description: Expose this agent in Ask Alaiy as a / skill. A skill runs with NO payload and for ANY user who can chat — the OS Agent Run permission is not the gate, because it grants System Manager only. Tick this only when every tool on this agent enforces its own permissions (read via frappe.get_list, never get_all) and none of them write.
fields.label: Available as Chat Skill

fields.description: What the user types after the slash, e.g. daily-digest. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.label: Skill Slug

fields.description: Name shown in the skill picker. Defaults to Agent Name.
fields.label: Skill Label

fields.description: Safety cap on LLM ↔ tool round-trips per run.
fields.label: Max Turns

fields.description: JSON Schema the arguments must satisfy when this pack is run as a skill. Leave empty for a pack that takes none — that is the default and the majority.
fields.label: Input Schema (JSON)

fields.description: JSON Schema the final output must satisfy.
fields.label: Output Schema (JSON)
